service.description: Start a download of all data of the owner of the logged in admin. System support can name any owner.

return.message: Only an administrator can download the company data

service.description: Upload a downloaded zip as a new owner, next to the data already here, in chunks (multipart, each below the proxy request limit). The first chunk (offset 0, no id) starts the upload, the last one (last=true) starts loading it. System support only.

parameter.name: offset
parameter.description: position of this chunk in the file

parameter.name: file
parameter.description: the chunk: a multipart FileItem, or bytes

return.message: An upload starts at the beginning of the file

service-call.name: update#growerp.general.OwnerDataTransfer
service-call.in-map: [ownerDataTransferId: old.ownerDataTransferId, status: 'FAILED', fileLocation: null, errorMessage: 'Upload not finished', completedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

return.message: A company data ${direction == 'EXPORT' ? 'download' : 'upload'} is already running, wait until it is finished

actions.script: File dir = new File(ec.factory.runtimePath + '/ownerData') dir.mkdirs() def created = ec.service.sync().name('create#growerp.general.OwnerDataTransfer') .parameters([ownerPartyId: ownerPartyId, direction: direction, status: direction == 'IMPORT' ? 'UPLOADING' : 'QUEUED', fileSize: 0, fileName: fileName, username: ec.user.username, createdDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp]) .requireNewTransaction(true).call() ownerDataTransferId = created.ownerDataTransferId String suffix = direction == 'IMPORT' ? '-upload.zip' : '.zip' ec.service.sync().name('update#growerp.general.OwnerDataTransfer') .parameters([ownerDataTransferId: ownerDataTransferId, fileLocation: new File(dir, ownerDataTransferId + suffix).path]) .requireNewTransaction(true).call()

service.description: Remove the files of downloads and uploads older than a week, they hold all data of an owner.
The background worker of a download or upload. An upload is loaded in one transaction: when it fails nothing is left behind.
A download or upload with its progress; without id the latest one of the owner (null if none). A finished download has a downloadPath, a link valid for 24 hours.

set.from: job.direction == 'EXPORT' && job.status == 'DONE' && job.downloadToken && job.completedDate && job.completedDate.time > ec.user.nowTimestamp.time - 24L * 3600 * 1000

[ownerDataTransferId: job.ownerDataTransferId, direction: job.direction, status: job.status, progress: job.progress, errorMessage: job.errorMessage, fileName: job.fileName, fileSize: job.fileSize, counts: job.countsJson ? new groovy.json.JsonSlurper().parseText(job.countsJson) : [:], newOwnerPartyId: job.newOwnerPartyId, createdDate: job.createdDate, completedDate: job.completedDate, downloadPath: downloadable ? '/ownerData/download?t=' + job.downloadToken : null]
